# space-screener-sdk

> Space Terminal screeners are Rust libraries (or TypeScript modules, `lang: ts`) compiled to wasm32-unknown-unknown (no WASI) and run by the terminal in an Extism sandbox. The plugin has no network, files, clock or threads: it calls host functions for data and HTTP and emits table rows. Crate `space-screener` (PDK), CLI `st`. Full contract: ABI.md. Agent guide: SKILL.md.

## Workflow
- `st init <dir> --id author.name` → Cargo.toml (cdylib), manifest.yaml, src/lib.rs
- `st build` → screener.wasm + the terminal's validation (manifest, imports, exports)
- `st dev` → install into the running terminal, open a pane, rebuild/reinstall on save, print log
- `st rows [--json]`, `st logs [-f]`, `st list` → inspect the running plugin
- `st record [--seconds N]` → restart the running plugin and save its data replies to recordings/<UTC>.json; `st test [--update]` → replay recordings headless, compare rows/alerts/status/clicks with recordings/*.expected.json (first run writes it)
- `st validate` → also prints `catalog: ready` or what the catalog lacks; `st login` (publish token stp_… from the store's author page; or ST_TOKEN) + `st publish [--recording FILE]` → upload to the Space Market registry; every version waits for a moderator (only when the user asks)
- TypeScript: `st init <dir> --lang ts` → package.json, tsconfig.json, src/index.ts, pdk/index.ts; `st build` needs Node 18+ (npm install once, tsc --noEmit) and fetches extism-js 1.7.0 + binaryen 133 once
- Terminal discovery: token `<data>/screeners/local_api_token`, port `<data>/config/general.yaml` (5055); `<data>` = `SPACE_TERMINAL_DIR` or OS data dir `Space Terminal`

## Code
- `use space_screener::prelude::*;` `#[derive(Default)] struct S;` `impl Screener for S { fn on_timer(&mut self, now_ms: i64) -> ScreenerResult {…} }` `export_screener!(S);`
- Optional: `init(&mut self, &Init)`, `on_params(&mut self, &Params)`; `params()`, `lang()` anywhere
- Clicks: rows with symbol/exchange/market open their order book at once without plugin code. Custom `on_click(&mut self, &Click)` only with `export_screener!(S, on_click)`; such clicks wait for a running on_timer — keep rounds short; arrow keys ↑/↓ (terminal 0.104.73+) arrive as a left click with column None and no modifiers, the terminal replaces the books they open
- Panics are logged with message and location (`st logs`) before the plugin restarts
- Host: `http(&HttpRequest::get(url))`, `http_batch(&reqs)` (8 concurrent, use for per-symbol endpoints), `tickers(ex, Market::Futures)`, `symbols(ex, market)`, `exchanges()`, `history_cluster`, `history_replay`, `kv_get/kv_set/kv_delete` (≤1 MiB), `replace_rows/emit_rows/expire`, `set_status(tone, text)`, `alert/alert_row` (≤6/min; info = quiet toast, warn/urgent = with sound), `open_market/open_spread` (only in on_click), v1.1 (min_terminal 0.104.72): `open_markets(&[MarketRef])` (≤16, in on_click), `open_market_with_level(&m, &SmartLevel::new(signal_id))`, `SignalFeed::new(SignalSource::Density).poll()` (live aggregator signals activity/density/prints, needs manifest `signals`; activity/prints only in the Pro terminal, else `unavailable`), `now_ms()`, `info!/warn!/error!/debug!`
- Symbols in rows/open_market: canonical upper-case BASEQUOTE (BTCUSDT, Hyperliquid BTCUSDC) recommended, native symbol also resolved; tickers()/symbols() return the terminal symbol + base/quote
- Row: `Row::new(key).market_ref(&MarketRef::new(ex, Market::Futures, sym)).cell("col", value).cell("chg", Cell::signed(x)).rank(n).ttl_s(s)`; cells keys = manifest column keys; at most 10000 rows or 32 MiB per plugin: beyond either cap the host evicts the least recently updated rows (replace: true with more rows keeps the last ones of the batch) — sort and truncate yourself
- `Series::new(mins(16))`: `push(ts, v)`, `value_at(ts)` = latest value at or before ts, `change_pct(now, mins(5))`; `secs/mins/hours` → ms; `params().f64_or/i64_or/bool_or/str`
- `st dev` reinstall on every save restarts the plugin and wipes in-memory history; keep small durable state in kv
- `st logs` gets `cpu … ms (… ms in host functions) of … ms, wall … ms` only when a call used ≥ 50 % of its CPU budget
- `space_screener::oi::Collector::new().collect(now_ms)?` → open interest (one side, USD) of USDT perps (Hyperliquid USDC; no quote filtering needed) for binance, bybit, okx, bitget, gate, mexc, kucoin, hyperliquid; `Collector::only(&[..])` polls a subset of `oi::EXCHANGES` (rotate groups per call to keep calls short; then timer_ms < 60 s is fine); manifest `http` must spell out fapi.binance.com, api.bybit.com, app.okx.com, api.bitget.com, api.gateio.ws, contract.mexc.com, api-futures.kucoin.com, api.hyperliquid.xyz; Snapshot `is_complete()`/`summary()` ("binance 180/200"); items: canonical `symbol`, `native_symbol`
- Binance OI is per symbol and fapi.binance.com is capped at 5 req/s by the terminal: N symbols ≈ N/5 s; the collector takes the top 200 by 24h volume (`set_binance_top_n(n)`, 1..=600, 600 = all)

## TypeScript
- `import { tickers, exchanges, http, httpBatch, kvGet, kvSet, replaceRows, emitRows, setStatus, alert, openMarket, openSpread, num, str, bool, params, signed, Series, mins } from "@space-terminal/screener"`; `export function init(input: InitInput)`, `export function on_timer(input: TimerInput)`; optional `on_click(input: ClickInput)`, `on_params`
- src/index.ts exports only init/on_timer/on_click/on_params; top-level code runs at BUILD time (no host calls there); host calls are sync and throw HostError (`e.code`); fetch → http for manifest hosts, console → log; async exports allowed; Math.random is not crypto; ~10× slower than Rust

## Manifest
- Required: `abi: 1`, `id` (^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{1,62}[a-z0-9]$, not `install` or `sync`, no con/prn/aux/nul/com1-9/lpt1-9 segment between dots), `version` (semver), `name {ru,en}`, `lang: rust|ts`, `min_terminal: 0.104.70`
- `http: [bare.host.names]` (every host called; no IP literals, no localhost), `timer_ms` (250..=3600000), `columns [{key, type, title{ru,en}, sort?: asc|desc, width?, show_if?: <bool param key>}]` (show_if hides the column while the bool param is false; terminal 0.104.73+, older shows it), `params [{key, type, title, default, min?, max?, options?}]`, `limits {memory_mb ≤64, cpu_ms_per_call 50..=1000}`, `history?: [cluster, replay]`, `signals?: [activity, density, prints]` (v1.1, min_terminal ≥ 0.104.72), `feeds: []`
- Column types: text number integer percent usd price time duration countdown symbol exchange exchanges bool; param types: number integer bool text select
- `install` and `sync` are reserved ids; duplicate hosts/columns/params are refused; column width 1..2000
- Catalog (st publish): `description {ru|en}` ≤ 2000 chars, `categories` 1..3 of volume open-interest funding spread movers listings orderbook other, optional `source: https://…`; version without build metadata; limits manifest ≤ 64 KiB, wasm ≤ 10 MiB with code section ≤ 4 MiB, recording ≤ 4 MiB, ≤ 3 pending versions per screener

## Limits and pitfalls
- 64 MB memory; cpu_ms_per_call (default 250, 50–1000) = plugin thread CPU for the whole call, wasm + host work for it (JSON, kv, rows), network wait free; past budget the next host call aborts; pure wasm loop cancelled after max(5×budget, 5 s) wall outside host functions; overrun/abort/runaway/600 s wall timeout = violation, 3 in last 10 calls → `limit`; CPU share ≤ 30 s per sliding 60 s (half a core, all calls incl. aborted) else `limit`; http timeout 1..10 s, body ≤8 MiB
- One call including HTTP waits must finish within 600 s wall; Binance per-symbol round ≈ N/5 s
- No std::time/fs/net/thread, no println (use info!), no wasm-bindgen deps (getrandom js, chrono wasmbind); extism-pdk logging/http imports are refused; start section and `_start`/`_initialize`/`__wasm_call_ctors`/`hs_init` exports are refused (forbidden_export)
- WebAssembly 2.0 + tail calls + extended-const only (no GC, threads/shared memory, memory64, multi-memory, exceptions, relaxed SIMD, components); import functions only, with exact signatures (host functions (i64)->i64, Extism kernel as extism-pdk 1.4.1 declares it); ≤ 20 tables, ≤ 50 000 table elements; ≤ 10 000 functions, ≤ 256 KiB per function body, nesting ≤ 2 000, br_table ≤ 10 000 targets — `invalid_wasm: function N` = one huge function (giant match/inline table): move data to a static, split it
- HTTP: https only, no redirects (3xx returned as is), no user info in URLs, timeout_ms 1000..=10000, body ≤ 8 MiB, http_batch bodies ≤ 48 MiB in total; rows ≤ 16 KiB each, ≤ 32 MiB in total
- Exchange slugs lowercase (binance, bybit, okx, bitget, gate, mexc, kucoin, bingx, hyperliquid); markets spot|futures
- Install st: `cargo install --git https://github.com/Space-Terminal/space-screener-sdk st` (st init then depends on the SDK by git); for SDK development `cargo install --path <sdk-checkout>/crates/st` (st init links to that checkout); `--sdk-path` overrides
